checks.name: manual
checks.cmd: uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 ; open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs in a browser ; repeat against the Docker container
checks.detail: A15 PERFORMED BY THE HUMAN USER and reported to the session. Result on BOTH bare uvicorn AND the Docker container: Swagger UI rendered at http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs, all 4 endpoints listed, and 'Try it out' on GET /products/search?q=may in returned HTTP 200 with total=4. EVIDENCE TIER IS `claimed`, NOT `anchored`, deliberately: harness/scripts/manual_test.py --anchor self-executes a command and captures its own output, so it structurally CANNOT anchor a visual browser render -- which is exactly why the plan classified A15 as `manual` (harness/rules/testability-triad.md). No anchor_id is cited because none exists; fabricating one would be rejected by the DoD gate and would be dishonest. The attestation is the user's; main only recorded it. SUPPORTING machine-checkable substrate independently verified by main (this does NOT prove the visual render, only that its preconditions hold): /docs returns 200 and the served HTML contains swagger-ui markup; /openapi.json lists exactly the 4 expected paths; /products/search?q=may in returns total=4 -- all consistent with the user's report. PLAN DEFECT NOTED: the phase file and plan.md both name `manual_test_anchor.py` as A15's anchor, but that script DOES NOT EXIST -- the real one is harness/scripts/manual_test.py. An eighth instance of a plan criterion referencing something never checked.
